sections.Profile:
The "Last Lap" pinball machine, produced by Spanish manufacturer Playmatic in September 1978, is a solid-state, four-player game with an auto racing theme. The playfield features two versions: one with three flippers and one pop bumper, and another with two flippers and two pop bumpers. Both versions include a 10-bank drop target assembly, a kick-out hole, a spinning target, and a horseshoe lane.

- Manufacturer: Playmatic
- Years made: 1978
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 4
